about: Snapshot of the team's approved 'AutoGMap Dispositions.xlsx' (2026-10-26): what each disposition must do.

rows.label: More information required
rows.does:
A WhatsApp message now to invite their questions
(The sheet's call is a WhatsApp nudge until WhatsApp calling is switched on)
rows.recorded: Bot: when they ask for Personal guidance. Team: in the Inbox
rows.after: Open: follow-ups run until they reply or upload

rows.label: Trust concern
rows.action: Bot answers who Eko is, with the website and our number; the team calls them
rows.does:
The bot answers who Eko is (Eko Bharat Ventures), with the website link and our number to call; at the documents step it adds the upload link
An hour later, the bot's reminder if they are quiet
2 hours after the answer (an hour after the reminder): ticket and email to Mansi and Kavya, unless the documents came in
Team to do: call them about their trust concern
rows.recorded: Bot: when they doubt Eko is genuine (“fraud”, “fake”, “vishwas nahi”, “વિશ્વાસ નથી”); the reminder and the team's email follow (see the next column)
rows.after: Open: follow-ups run until they reply or upload

rows.label: Callback requested
rows.action: Call & WhatsApp notification for call back confirmation
rows.does:
A WhatsApp message now to confirm we will get back to them at their time
A WhatsApp message at the time you set to get back to them, as promised
(The sheet's call is a WhatsApp nudge until WhatsApp calling is switched on)
rows.recorded: Bot: reads it from their reply, e.g. “call me”, “call kijiye”. Team: in the Inbox
rows.after: Open: follow-ups run until they reply or upload

rows.label: Documents pending
rows.does:
A WhatsApp message now to remind them to upload their documents

(The sheet's call is a WhatsApp nudge until WhatsApp calling is switched on)
rows.recorded: Bot: records it itself when it sends the document upload link
rows.after: Open: follow-ups run until they reply or upload

rows.label: Interested: in the bot's questions
rows.does: The bot asks its questions one by one; one reminder after an hour of silence
rows.recorded: Bot: while the lead answers the bot's questions (language, PIN, education, investment)
rows.after: Open: follow-ups run until they reply or upload

rows.label: Not qualified for SBI branch code
rows.action: Journey continues; kept for another proposal (BT, HDFC...)
rows.does: Nothing extra is sent: the bot carries on with education, investment and documents like anyone interested
rows.recorded: Bot: when the lead sends a real PIN code outside our SBI branch area. The journey carries on; the lead is kept with the qualified leads (see the Qualification sheet)
rows.after: Open: follow-ups run until they reply or upload
